integrity: Theorem and bounds analytically proved in RESULT.md; 151 deterministic numerical identities are supplementary and do not certify global claims.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a single drift-free planar Gaussian Stratonovich rotational diffusion and the explicitly half-scaled Cayley step.
Only the first and second Fourier modes have complete positive-root classifications; mode m in general has an at-most-m bound.
Root decimals are numerical approximations, not independently certified interval enclosures.
Historical publication priority is not independently guaranteed.
title: Exact reentrant Fourier-correlation frontiers for Gaussian Cayley steps on the circle
